subject: Bank sweep applied to parent — request to reallocate unapplied credits to subsidiary invoices
messages:
From: BrightByte Payments <payments@brightbyte.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Remittance advice — sweep applied to parent entity (needs reallocation)

Hi Jordan,

Quick heads up — our treasury team processed the consolidated bank sweep yesterday (ACH trace: 20270613-ACH-88742) and the funds posted to BrightByte Inc. (parent entity). When our AP team exported remittance lines, several invoice-level references for the subsidiary (BrightByte EU and BrightByte Services) were stripped by the bank defaulting the beneficiary to the parent account number.

Affected invoices: BB-EU-4352 (EUR 12,400), BB-SV-1809 (USD 3,200), BB-SV-1810 (USD 1,800). Total: EUR 12,400 + USD 5,000 (converted to USD bank posting).

We attached the remittance PDF and the ACH advice. Can you advise the quickest way for Redwood to reallocate these amounts back to the invoice numbers so your ledger reflects applied payments? If you need a reissue from our side with explicit invoice refs, we can have Treasury reissue, but prefer to avoid another ACH if you can reapply internally.

Attachments: BrightByte_REM_20270613.pdf (remittance scan), bank-advice-ACH.txt (bank posting details).

Apologies for the hassle — let me know what evidence you need and we will provide it.

Thanks,

Lara Kim
Payments Manager
BrightByte Inc.
payments@brightbyte.com

---

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, BrightByte Payments <payments@brightbyte.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Remittance advice — sweep applied to parent entity (needs reallocation)

Forwarding — BrightByte's sweep posted to parent and some subsidiary invoice refs were lost. They can reissue but prefer we reallocate internally to avoid another transfer.

Aditya / Monica — can Finance reapply the unapplied credit to the invoice numbers below? If you need a GL correction or a manual journal, say so and I will sign off.

Invoice list (from BrightByte):
- BB-EU-4352 — EUR 12,400
- BB-SV-1809 — USD 3,200
- BB-SV-1810 — USD 1,800

Attached: BrightByte_REM_20270613.pdf, bank-advice-ACH.txt

If reapplication looks risky (tax/VAT audit trail), Vanessa, please confirm if BrightByte's treasury can issue a corrected remittance CSV (with invoice refs) and provide the ACH trace for our bank reconciliation.

Jordan Blake
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, BrightByte Payments <payments@brightbyte.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 13:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Remittance advice — sweep applied to parent entity (needs reallocation)

Thanks Jordan — looping in Finance.

Quick plan of action from our side:
1) We can reapply internally but require a remittance CSV or a spreadsheet with invoice refs + posted amounts to match to bank posting. The attached template helps us capture the mapping (unapplied-credit-recon-template.xlsx).
2) For the EUR invoice (BB-EU-4352) we need the original EUR amount and the bank FX rate used by your bank when converting to USD (if conversion already occurred). Otherwise internal exchange adjustments will be required.
3) Please confirm the posted bank credit (USD posted amount) and provide the ACH trace ID (we will request a bank statement extract).
4) If BrightByte can quickly reissue a corrected remittance CSV (same-day) with explicit invoice numbers, that shortens audit trail concerns — Finance prefers this. If not, we will post an internal journal and apply credits to the three invoices; we will also annotate the audit entry with the attached bank advice and your confirmation.

Can BrightByte send: 1) a remittance CSV (CSV preferred) with invoice refs and 2) a copy of the bank statement line showing the ACH trace? If you can’t share the statement, the ACH advice text you already sent might suffice.

Timeline: If we receive the CSV + trace by EOD PST tomorrow, Finance will post allocations by Thu EOD and confirm via email with references to our GL transaction IDs. If we do an internal journal, Jordan — I will need a one-line approval from you to post manual reallocation entries that touch AR and unapplied credits.

Attaching: unapplied-credit-recon-template.xlsx (for internal use).

Regards,
Aditya Rao
Senior Manager, Finance
Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com

From: BrightByte Payments <payments@brightbyte.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Remittance advice — corrected remittance CSV attached

Hi all,

Thanks for the quick reply. Attached is the corrected remittance CSV (BRIGHTBYTE_REMATCH_20270614.csv) that includes invoice-level references for BB-EU-4352, BB-SV-1809 and BB-SV-1810. Treasury also confirmed the ACH trace: 20270613-ACH-88742 and included the bank's payment reference (BB-SWEEP-20270613).

We have not initiated a second payment — this is the same funds, we simply exported a corrected remittance file for your posting. Please confirm once you have applied the credits so we can close the item on our side.

Attachment: BRIGHTBYTE_REMATCH_20270614.csv (remittance CSV).

Best,
Lara Kim
Payments Manager
BrightByte Inc.
payments@brightbyte.com
